chapters.title: Chapter 1 - The Memorial
chapters.summary_simple: Chapter 1 begins at a memorial service in Liberia. Bendu Lewis remembers family, loss, and Granny May.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - In The Cause of The People
chapters.summary_simple: Moses Varney arrives at the Temple of Justice. He meets street boys Simeon and Alphonso who call him Brother V.
chapters.summary_detailed: Moses Varney with his bodyguard Weah parks at the Temple of Justice. He meets teenage boys near Capitol Bypass who know him as Brother V. He remembers losing his parents at age 11 in a bus accident from Sanniquellie to Monrovia. He reflects on justice in Liberia and promises he will not forget the boys.
chapters.setting: Temple of Justice, Capitol Bypass, Monrovia
chapters.moral_lesson: True peace cannot exist without justice and equity for the masses.
